    • Method Detail

      • replaceXMLEvent

        private void replaceXMLEvent()
                      throws java.io.IOException
        Scans every cell iteratively located in the first worksheet and replaces inline strings with shared strings.

        Important: be mindful this method focuses on processing the first worksheet of the spreadsheet only.

        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - if there is any problem

      • processStart

        private void processStart(javax.xml.stream.events.XMLEvent event)
                   throws javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException
        Receives notification of the start of an element for processing. If the event identifies the current cell containing the inlineStr value, then it will be marked for replacement.
        Parameters:
        event - the XMLEvent event pointing to the current element being seen
        Throws:
        javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException - if there is any streaming problem

      • processEnd

        private void processEnd(javax.xml.stream.events.XMLEvent event)
                 throws javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException
        Receives notification of the end of an element for processing. If the inlineStr value is identified in the current iteration, it will be replaced with the shared string.
        Parameters:
        event - the XMLEvent event pointing to the current element being seen
        Throws:
        javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException - if there is any streaming problem
